Name: FF3.0_LBXLW's RedFox and RainFrog Outdoor Large Furniture Catalogue
Author: labixiaoluwan
Description:
[size=4]
Outdoor furnitures designed to match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34044][RedFox and RainFrog Furniture][/url] and [/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34168][RedFox and RainFrog Farmhouse][/url] .
[/size]
[size=5][b]
Compatible with [ FF 3.0.5 ]

[/b][/size]If you are using FF2.0 , please download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34746][b][ FF2.0_LBXLW's RedFox and RainFrog Outdoor Large Furniture Catalogue ][/b][/url] .

Since there are still many players using FF2.0, I will not combine these two mods so that I can update the two versions of new outdoor furniture at the same time in the future.
因为很多玩家还在使用2.0版本的FF，我没有把这两个版本合并在同一个mod页面里，以方便以后同时更新2.0和3.0版本的室外家具。


﻿This set has Chinese and English Versions.
这个系列有 中文版 和 英语版 。


[size=5]How to use this mod（如何使用这个模组）：[/size]

1. Pre-mod:
[list]
[*]   SMAPI;
[*]   Furniture Framework ([size=4]Version:3.0.5[/size]) 
[/list]1.前置mod:
[list]
[*] SMAPI;
[*] Furniture Framework ([size=4]Version:3.0.5[/size])
[/list]
2. Buy “RedFox And RainFrog Outdoor Catalogue”:
   From the Robin’s  OR  the Furniture Catalogue. 
2.购买“赤狐与雨蛙室外家具目录”:
 从罗宾处，或者直接从“家具目录”购买。

3. Placed the catalogue  and get furnitures as you like.
3.放置目录桌，选择您喜欢的家具。

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
如果您是中国玩家，可以关注我的小红书账号：小鹿丸与草莓（小红书号：26201926633），我会在那里更新我的mod制作的相关讯息。希望大家喜欢我的作品！
